requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the same headphones, is there reliable evidence of relevant attempted movement without fulfillment, is there reliable evidence that no relevant progress occurred, or is the result unresolved?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. Fail only when visual evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward moving the source mug occurred. Evidence of attempted movement without fulfillment is also fail for this required condition. Assess the source mug's former location and the edited scene for evidence of attempted movement, but do not infer progress from blue color alone, from the presence of a right-side mug, or from unrelated or newly generated mugs. A remnant counts as evidence of attempted movement only when its shape, position, and appearance reliably connect it to the source mug. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish fulfillment or whether relevant progress occurred.
nodes.binding: Compare the source image's large light-blue mug, including its body and handle, with each edited mug, allowing for changes in appearance, scale, and lighting; compare the same headphones and assess whether the source mug is to their right. Explicitly inspect the source mug's former location and the surrounding edited scene: assess the remnant's position, outline, and appearance, and whether these together with other visible changes reliably indicate attempted movement of the source mug. Do not treat color alone, an indistinct blur, or a different-looking mug as proof of identity or progress. Keep attempted movement distinct from fulfillment; retain unresolved if identity or movement cannot reliably be established.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source shows a large light-blue mug left of the headphones. In the edited image, a mug is to the right of the headphones, but it looks different from the source mug; another mug appears left of the headphones, and the source mug's former location is only an indistinct blue blur. The blur and visible mugs do not reliably establish whether the source mug was moved, so neither fulfillment nor relevant attempted movement can be confirmed.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image provide reliable visual evidence that the source mug itself was moved to the right of the same headphones, rather than merely showing a different mug there?
findings.criteria: Compare the source mug’s distinctive body and handle with the right-side edited mug, allowing for scale and appearance changes. Assess whether the edited mug’s shape, handle, and other visible details reliably establish identity; do not infer identity from its position alone. Keep identity evidence separate from evidence of attempted movement.
findings.evidence: The source has one large light-blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image shows a small pale mug left of the headphones, a pale mug to their right, and a blue blur at the source mug’s former location. The right-side mug has a visible handle but appears substantially different in size and appearance from the source mug.
findings.rationale: The existing check notes that the right-side mug looks different and leaves identity unresolved, but does not separately investigate whether its visible shape and handle could nevertheless establish it as the source mug. This identity question is central to judging the requested move; the blur and additional mug make position alone insufficient.
